source.dataset: iB5000 closed ContourPoly land extent; connected iB1000 HydroPolygon rivers/channels
source.derivation: Sea is the bounded complement of original closed land polygons, plus intersecting explicit RIV/CHA/NUL polygons. No manual shoreline gap closure or raster tracing.
source.coordinatePrecision: Original GML coordinates retained; precision is not a survey accuracy claim.
source.verticalNote: The -4m render bed is illustrative and is not bathymetry. Raw source elevation arrays and source building geometry remain unchanged.
